name: dependency-supplychain-plugin
description: Dependency & Supply-Chain Hygiene for Java — scans Maven pom.xml and SBOMs for outdated, vulnerable, unlicensed and risky dependencies (OWASP Dependency-Check + Grype), scores each dependency by CVE severity and business criticality (NVD CVSS), auto-remediates with version-bump PRs, and gates PR merges on test + scan results with a full audit trail.
